responses.response: Use Container_Api for a backend API or service. Container_API is not declared in the shared taxonomy, and Container is only the generic base kind. In projects/shared/spec-containers.c4, the relevant C2 taxonomy is the base Container plus specialized kinds such as Container_Api and Container_Database. In the logical model, the relationship kinds defined in projects/shared/spec-global.c4 are exactly uses, calls, async, reads, and writes. Toward a database, the database-specific choices are reads and writes; uses is only the generic fallback, while calls is the synchronous service-call relationship rather than the database-specific one. To verify in this workspace, inspect the element declarations in projects/shared/spec-containers.c4 and the relationship declarations in projects/shared/spec-global.c4.

Between an application VM and a database VM in deployment, use sql when you want to model database traffic precisely. tcp is the generic transport-level fallback, and calls is not a deployment relationship in this workspace. The deployment relationship set is defined in projects/shared/spec-deployment.c4. In the logical application model, the valid relationship kinds remain uses, calls, async, reads, and writes from projects/shared/spec-global.c4, with reads and writes being the best fit for application-to-database behavior. The shared cheat sheet also says normal application traffic should usually stay in the logical model and flow into deployment through instanceOf, so add explicit deployment edges only when you need infrastructure-specific detail.

The exact firewall deployment kind is Infra_Fw. Infra_Firewall is not declared. Two nearby valid deployment infrastructure kinds in the same shared taxonomy are Infra_F5 and Infra_Router. You can verify all three by checking the deploymentNode declarations in projects/shared/spec-deployment.c4.

The exact declared kinds are HTTP API = Container_Api and message queue = Container_Queue. There is no dedicated Container_Worker kind declared in projects/shared/spec-containers.c4, so do not invent one. For an async worker, the closest explicit processing-oriented kind is Container_ProcessingServer; if none of the named subtypes fit, use the generic Container base rather than guessing a nonexistent subtype. To find kinds in this workspace, inspect the element declarations in projects/shared/spec-containers.c4 and use projects/shared/SPEC_CHEATSHEET.md only as a quick index. When two names look similar, the exact identifier declared in the .c4 spec file wins. For example, Container_Api is valid but Container_API is not.

For a web application talking to an API in the logical model, use calls, not https. The logical relationship kinds are defined in projects/shared/spec-global.c4, and https is not one of them. If you want to record the protocol, keep the logical relationship kind as calls and capture HTTPS as the interaction technology. The relationship kind https becomes valid only in deployment or infrastructure modeling, because it is declared in projects/shared/spec-deployment.c4 as a deployment relationship.
